Kaf-Hha-Ya-’Ayin-Swad.
Lokho ukulandisa ngomusa weNkosi yakho esigqileni saYo uZakariya.
Mhla ekhuleka eNkosini yakhe ngasese.
Wathi: “Nkosi yami, amathambo ami asebuthaka nekhanda lami seliqhakazile futhi angikaze ngibuye neze lapho ngikhuleka kuWe Nkosi yami”.
Nebala ngesaba izihlobo emuva kokuba ngingasekho kunjalo nje umkami akazele, ngakhoke ngiphe umsizi ovela kuWe”.
Oyoba indlalifa yami neyomndeni kaYakubu, futhi Nkosi yami, umenze athandeke.
Zakariya, impela sikuhalalisela ngomfana ogama lakhe kuzoba ngu Yahiya, akekho esike samqamba lona phambilini.
Wathi:”Nkosi yami, ngizomthola kanjani umfana ebe umfazi wami eyinumba kulapho nami ngizigugele ngingumxhiliba na?”
Yathi [ingelosi]: “Isho njalo iNkosi yakho, yathi: kulula kimi [ukudala umfana], belu ngakudala nawe phambilini ube wawukade ungelutho”.
Wathi [uZakariya]: “Nkosi yami, ngiphe uphawu”. Yathi: “Yathi uphawu lwakho ukuthi ungakwazi ukukhulumisa abantu izinsuku ezintathu”.
Waphuma egunjini lokuthandaza waya ebandleni lakhe, wabayalela ukuba badumise ekusenu nakusihlwa.
Yahiya, thatha iNcwadi [iTora] ngokuzimisela futhi samunika ukuqonda esasemncane.
Samupha futhi ububele obuvela kithi kanye nobumsulwa, futhi wayemthobela u Allah.
Futhi wayehlonipha abazali bakhe engewona umdlwembe oweyisayo.
Ukuthula makube kuye ngosuku azalwa ngalo nangosuku afa ngalo nangosuku ayovuswa ngalo [ekufeni] aphile.
Landisa [wena Muhamadi] lapha eNcwadini [iKurani] ngoMariyamu, mhla eqhela ngasemndenini wakhe wayohlala endaweni engasempumalanga.
Wazibekela isisithezo ezisitha kubo [abantu bakubo]. Sabe sesithumela kuye ingelosi yeThu [uJibhirili] eyathatha isimo somuntu oqotho phambi kwakhe.
Wathi [uMariyamu]: “Ngizivikela ngoNomusa kuwe uma ngempela umthobela u Allah”.
Yathi [ingelosi]: “Ngiyisithunywa nje seNkosi yakho, esithunywe ukukulethela umfana omsulwa”.
Wathi: “Ngingamthola kanjani umfana ngingakaze ngithintwe muntu [wesilisa] futhi ngingakaze ngibe unondindwa”.
Yathi: “Isho kanjalo iNkosi yakho: kulula kiMi, futhi siyomenza isibonakaliso ebantwini nomusa ovela kithi. Futhi yinto vele esinqunyiwe.
Wamthwala [ekhulelwe] waya naye endaweni esekudeni eqhelile.
Wahlaselwa umhelo ehleli ngaphansi kwesihlahla samasundu, wathi: “Ngifisa ukube ngafa kudala ngaphambi kwalokhu ngakhohlwa ngangaziwa nhlobo”.
Wammemeza [umfana wakhe] ngenzansi kwakhe wathi: “Ungakhathazeki ngokuba iNkosi yakho wenze umfundlana ezansi kwakho”.
Nyakazisela ngakuwe isiqu sesihlahla sizokuwisela amasundu amasha avunwe ngaleso sikhathi.
Yidla uphuze uthokoze. Uma ubona noma yimuphi umuntu, ubothi: “Ngizibophezele ku Allah ukuba ngizile, ngakhoke akukho muntu engiyomkhulumisa namhlanje”.
Wafika naye [umfana wakhe] kubantu bakubo emphethe. Bathi: “We Mariyamu, impela ufike nento eyinsumansumane”.
Dadewabo ka Haruna, uyihlo wayengeyena umuntu omubi futhi nonyoko wayengeyena unondindwa.
Wavele wabakhomba kuye [umfana wakhe]. Bathi: “Sizokhuluma kanjani noswana olusembelekweni na?”
Wathi [umfana kaMariyamu]: “Mina ngiyisigqila sika Allah, unginike iNcwadi wangenza iSithunywa”.
Futhi wangenza ngaba obusisekile noma yikuphi langikhona, wangiyalela ngeswala nezakati uma nje lokhu ngisaphila.
Futhi wangenza ngaba ohlonipha umama wami, akazange angenze umdlwembe ongezwa.
Ukuthula makube kimi ngosuku lapho ngizalwa nangosuku lapho ngifa nangosuku lapho ngivuswa ngiphile.
Loyo ngu Isa indodana ka Mariyamu. Amazwi eqiniso leli abalingabazayo.
Akumfaneli u Allah ukuba abe nengane; makangcweliswe. Uma efuna ukwenza noma yini, uvane kuyo: “Yenzeka”, bese iyenzeka.
Nebala u Allah iNkosi yami neNkosi yenu, ngakhoke mkhonzeni, iyona lena indlela eqondile.
Aphikisana wodwa amaqembu, imbubhiso ikulabo abangakholelwa ekubuthaneni koSuku olukhulu.
Yeka abayokubona nabayokuzwa ngosuku abayofika ngalo kithi. Kepha labo abangakholwa basekudukeni okusobala namhlanje.
Baxwayise ngosuku lokuzisola lapho okuyokwehlulelwa khona. Kulapho bona abanendaba futhi abakholwa.
Nembala yithina esiyoba yizindlalifa zomhlaba nakho konke okukuwo futhi bonke bayobuyela kithi.
Futhi landisa ngo Ibhirahimu eNcwadini [iKurani]. Impela wayeneqiniso eyiSithunywa.
Mhla ethi kuyise: “Baba wami othandekayo, kungani ukhonza lokho okungezwa nokungaboni okungakusizi ngalutho”.
Baba wami othandekayo, impela senginolwazi olungakafiki kuwe, ngakhoke landela mina ngikuholele endleleni eqondile.
Baba wami othandekayo ungamkhonzi uShayitani ngokuba uShayitani weyisa wangamlalela Onomusa [uAllah].
Baba wami othandekayo, impela ngisaba ukuthi uyothola isijeziso esivela koNomusa bese uphenduka umlandeli ka Shayitani.
Wathi [uyise]: “Awunandaba nezikhonzwa zami na, we Ibhirahimu?” Uma ungaphezi ngizokukhanda ngamatshe mina uqobo futhi awungiyeke [ungangikhulumisi]isikhathi eside.
Wathi [u Ibhirahimu]: “Ukuthula makube kuwe. Ngizokucelela intethelelo eNkosini yami ngokuba yona inesihawu kimi”.
Futhi ngizonishiya nina kanye nalokho enikukhonzayo ngaphandle kuka Allah, bese ngikhuleka eNkosini yami, hleze ngingehluleki lapho sengikhulekile eNkosini yami.
Kuthe lapho esebahlubukile kanye nalokho ababekukhonza ngaphandle kuka Allah, samupha u Isihaki noYakubu. Bobabili sabenza iZithunywa.
Sabapha nabo emseni weThu sabenzela ukutuswa kweqiniso okungapheli.
Landisa futhi ngoMusa eNcwadini [iKurani]. Impela wayekhethekile futhi wabe eyiSithunywa esinguMembulelwa.
Sammemeza ngasohlangothini lwesokudla lwentaba iTuri, samsondeza sakhuluma naye.
Samupha emseni weThu umfowabo uHaruna owaba yiSithunywa.
Landisa futhi ngo Isima’ili eNcwadini [iKurani]. Impela wayesigcina isithembiso futhi wabe eyiSithunywa esinguMembulelwa.
Wayehlala najlo eluleka umndeni wakhe ngeswala nezakati futhi wayethandeka eNkosini yakhe.
Landisa futhi ngo Idirisi eNcwadini [iKurani]. Impela wayeneqiniso futhi eyiSithunywa.
Futhi samnyukisela esikhundleni esiphezulu.

Yibona ke labo u Allah ababusisile eZithunyweni nakuzalo luka Adamu nakulabo esabathwala kanye noNuhu nakuzalo luka Ibhirahimu nakulabo esabahola sabakhetha. Uma befundelwa imibiko yoNomusa, bawa phansi ngobuso bakhothame futhi bekhala.
Kepha balandelwa emuva kwabo yisizukulwane esasingenandaba neswala futhi silandela izinkanuko. Siyohlangabezana nokubi [eJahanamu].
Ngaphandle kwalowo ozisolayo akholwe bese enza izenzo ezinhle, yilaboke abayongena eJana futhi akukho noncane okungebona ubulungiswa okuyokwenziwa kubo.
Izivande zaphakade lezi Onomusa azithembise izigqila zaKhe zingazibonanga. Impela isithembiso saKhe nakanjani siyofika.
Abayikuzwa kuzo umbhedo ngaphandle nje kokuthi “ukuthula” [bebingelelana]. Bayothola ukudla kwabo kuzo ekuseni nakusihlwa.
Iyonake leyo iJana esiyoyenza ifa lalabo abangithobelayo kuzigqila zaMi.

[Yithi wena Jibhirili kuMuhamadi]: “Asehlingaphandle komyayelo kaAllah. Konke okungaphambi kwethu [okuzayo] nokusemuva kwethu [okwendlule] nokumaphakathi kwalokho kungokuka Allah. Futhi iNkosi yakho ayikhohlwa”.
UyiNkosi yamazulu nomhlaba nokumaphakathi kwakho. Ngakhoke khonzani Yena nibambelele ekukhonzeni Yena [Yedwa]. Ingabe ukhona yini omunye omaziyo ofana naYe na?
Umuntu uthi: “Ingabe uma sengifile ngiyophinde ngivuswe ngiphile na?”
Ingabe umuntu akasakhumbuli yini ukuthi samdala phambilini ebengelutho.
Ngiyifunge iNkosi yakho, siyobabuthanisa bonke kanye noShayitani ndawonye bese sibaletha baphahle iJahanamu beguqile.
Emuva kwalokho siyobe sesihlunga kuwo wonke amaqembu [aphambukile] lowo obeyisa u Allah kakhulu.
Futhi esibazikahle labo abanelwe ukungena kuyo [iJahanamu].
Futhi akekho kini nonke ongeke angena kuyo. Leso isinqumo seNkosi yakho esingeguqulwe.
Siyobahlenga labo abathobela uAllah kuthi labo abaphambukile sibayeke kanjalo phakathi kuyo beguqile.
Uma befundelwa imibiko yeThu ecacile, laba abangakholwa bathi kulabo abakholwayo: “Yilona liphi iqembu kwamabili [thina nani] elinemizi engcono nenkundla [yokuhlangana] engcono [ngobuningi] na?”
Ziningi izizwe ngaphambi kwabo esazibhubhisa, ababenempahla yasendlini enhle futhi bebukeka kahle.

Yithi: “Lowo odukile, Onomusa uyomengezela isikhathi, kuze kube yilapho bebona lokho abathenjiswe kona. Isijeziso noma iSikhathi [sokwahlulelwa]. Bayokwazike [ngalowo mzuzu] ukuthi ubani kahle empeleni ononendawo yokuhlala embi nonebutho elingatheni.
Labo abasendleleni eqondile u Allah uyobengezela ukuqonda. Futhi izenzo ezinhle yizona ezingcono eNkosini yakho ngomvuzo nangesiphetho.
Uyambona lona ongakholwa imibiko yeThu kepha athi: “Ngizophiwa umcebo nezingane”.
Ingabe wazi ikusasa [elingabonwa] noma wenze isivemelwano Allah na?
Phinde! Sizokuqopha lokhu akushoyo bese simengezela isijeziso ngaphezulu.
Futhi yithina esiyosala nalokhu akushoyo [umcebo nezingane zakhe] bese eza kithi eyedwa qwaba.
Baqoka izikhonzwa ngaphandle kuka Allah ukuze zibe usizo kubo.
Phinde! Ziyokuphika ukukhonzwa yibo [emhlabeni] bese ziba izitha kubo.
Ubonile yini ukuthi sithumele oShayitani kulabo abangakholwa belokhu bebakuthazisisa [ekwenzeni okubi].
Ungabajahi. Impela silokhu siyababalela nje.
Mhla siyobuthanisela koNomusa labo abathobela u Allah njengezicukuthwane.
Siqhubele izigilamkhuba eJahanamu beshaya ngobhadu bonyiwe.
Abakwazi ukushweleza ngaphandle kwalowo owenze isivumelwano no Allah.
Futhi bathi Onomusa unengane.
Impela nenze into eshaqisayo.
Kangangokuthi amazulu acishe asakazela aqhephuka ngakho kanjalo nomhlaba ucishe waqhekeka nezintaba zadilika.
Ngokuthi nje nithi Onomusa unengane.
Akadingi Onomusa ukaba abe nengane.
Ngokuba konke okusemazulwini nasemhlabeni kuyofika kuNomusa njengezigqila.
Impela ubazi bonke futhi ubabale bonke.
Futhi bonke bayofika kuYe ngoSuku lokwahlulela ngamunye vo.
Nebala labo abakholwayo benze nezenzo ezinhle, Onomusa uyobenzela uthando.
Impela siyenze lula [iKurani] ngolwimi lwakho ukuze wethule ngayo izindaba ezinhle kwabakholwayo uphinde uxwayise ngayo abantu abathanda ukuphikisa kakhulu.
Futhi ziningi izizwe ezibandelelayo esazibhubhisa. Ingabe ukhona noyedwa wabo ombonayo noma uzwe nje umsinjwana wabo na?
